items.period: Seal-script style, representing the Shuowen seal tradition; modern vector uploaded 2012, revised 2022
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 事 in a Shuowen-style seal script. It illustrates the received seal form, not an ancient artifact or the disputed object in the oracle-bone graph.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 事 centered on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description identifies the graph and script style, provides the original SVG, and states public-domain reuse terms. It can illustrate the later seal-script form while making clear it is a modern redraw.
items.rights: Public domain, according to the file description; representation predates modern copyright and the creator released any rights in the file.

limitations.text: No selected image shows a directly photographed oracle-bone or bronze specimen. The only verified candidate is a modern vector of a received Shuowen-style seal form; it must not be captioned as an artifact photo.
